items.text: What do the different stages in the tracker mean?

llm.label: in_handoff
llm.reply:
PARTIAL 

The stages in the tracker mean: Your money’s being processed: This means we’re still waiting to receive the money from your bank. Money received: This means we’ve got your money and we’re converting it to the new currency. Transfer Sent: We’ve now sent the money to your recipient’s bank. From here, their bank will process and deliver the money. This can take a few working days. Anything else about your transfer?
